****************************************************************      
* PROGRAM NAME                 : PRINTCI                       *      
* IMPORTANT FILE               : TICKET PRINT.                 *      
* PROGRAMMER                   : KERESTES                      *      
* DATE OF WRITEN               : SEPT. 2022                    *      
* TECHNOLOGY                   : COBOL + JCL                   *      
****************************************************************      
*                   PROBLEM  DEFINITION                        *      
*                                                              *      
*   THE PROGRAM RECEIVE THE PASSENGER INFORMATION AND CREATE   *      
*                     THE PRINT TICKET                         *      
****************************************************************      
* INPUT PARAMETERS:                                            *      
*                                                              *      
* PASSENGERS INFORMATION - ACCEPT STATEMENT                    *      
****************************************************************      
* OUTPUT PARAMETERS:                                           *      
*                                                              *      
* PRINT DOCUMENT                                               *      
****************************************************************      
                                                                      
****************************************************************      
*                  IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                    *      
****************************************************************      
                                                                      
 IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                                             
 PROGRAM-ID. PRINTCI.                                                 
                                                                      
****************************************************************      
*                       DATA DIVISION.                         *      
****************************************************************      
                                                                      
 DATA DIVISION.                                                       
                                                                      
*------------------------*                                            
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.                                           
*------------------------*                                          
                                                                    
****************************************************************    
*                         WS VARAIBLES                         *    
****************************************************************    
                                                                    
 01 TABLE-PRINT.                                                    
    02 FULL-NAME                    PIC X(45).                      
    02 FSEAT                        PIC X(3).                       
    02 FLIGHTNUM                    PIC X(6).                       
    02 DAIR                         PIC X(4).                       
    02 LAIR                         PIC X(4).                       
    02 FDATE                        PIC X(10).                      
    02 TDEP                         PIC X(5).                       
    02 FULLDATE                     PIC X(9).                       
    02 FULLCITY1                    PIC X(20).                      
    02 FULLCITY2                    PIC X(20).                      
                                                                    
 01 TICKET-LINE                     PIC X(95).                      
                                                                    
****************************************************************    
*                     PROCEDURE DIVISION.                      *    
****************************************************************    
                                                                    
 PROCEDURE DIVISION.                                                
                                                                    
 MAIN-PARA.                                                         
                                                                    
     PERFORM 0100-ACCEPT                                            
     PERFORM 0200-DISPLAY                                           
                                                                    
     GOBACK.                                                        
                                                                    
****************************************************************    
* 0100-ACCEPT                                                  *    
*                                                              * 
* ACCEPT THE DATA FROM A JCL JOB                               * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0100-ACCEPT. 
                                                                  
     ACCEPT FULL-NAME 
     ACCEPT FSEAT 
     ACCEPT FLIGHTNUM 
     ACCEPT DAIR 
     ACCEPT LAIR 
     ACCEPT FDATE 
     ACCEPT TDEP 
     ACCEPT FULLDATE 
     ACCEPT FULLCITY1 
     ACCEPT FULLCITY2. 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
* 0300-DISPLAY                                                 * 
*                                                              * 
* IT DISPLAY THE INFORMATIONS FROM THE CLIENT AND FLIGHT.      * 
* THE JOB WHICH WILL CALL THIS PROGRAM MUST CHOOSE THE PRINTER * 
* MSGCLASS ( JOB MSGCLASS=PRINTER) DEFINED BY THE ADMINSTRATOR * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 0200-DISPLAY. 
                                                                  
                                                                  
     MOVE '|' TO TICKET-LINE(70:1) 
     DISPLAY TICKET-LINE. 
                                                                  
     MOVE 'BORDING PASS               COBOL AIRLINES' TO 
                                TICKET-LINE(11:45) 
     MOVE '|' TO  TICKET-LINE(70:1) 
     DISPLAY TICKET-LINE. 
                                                                  
      MOVE SPACE TO TICKET-LINE 
     MOVE '|' TO  TICKET-LINE(70:1) 
     MOVE FULL-NAME (1:20) TO TICKET-LINE(73:20) 
     DISPLAY TICKET-LINE. 
                                                                  
     MOVE SPACE TO TICKET-LINE 
     MOVE 'PASSENGER NAME' TO TICKET-LINE(11:15) 
     MOVE 'SEAT' TO TICKET-LINE(54:4) 
     MOVE '|' TO TICKET-LINE(70:1) 
     MOVE 'FROM:' TO TICKET-LINE(73:5) 
     MOVE DAIR TO TICKET-LINE(79:3) 
     MOVE 'TO:' TO TICKET-LINE(84:3) 
     MOVE LAIR TO TICKET-LINE(88:3) 
     DISPLAY TICKET-LINE 
                                                                  
     MOVE SPACE TO TICKET-LINE 
     MOVE FULL-NAME TO TICKET-LINE(11:45) 
     MOVE FSEAT TO TICKET-LINE(54:3) 
     MOVE '|' TO TICKET-LINE(70:1) 
     DISPLAY TICKET-LINE 
                                                                  
     MOVE SPACE TO TICKET-LINE 
     MOVE '|' TO TICKET-LINE(70:1) 
     MOVE 'FLIGHT:' TO TICKET-LINE(73:7) 
     MOVE FLIGHTNUM TO TICKET-LINE(81:6) 
     DISPLAY TICKET-LINE 
                                                                  
     MOVE SPACE TO TICKET-LINE 
     MOVE 'FROM:' TO TICKET-LINE(11:5) 
     MOVE FULLCITY1 TO TICKET-LINE(17:20) 
     MOVE 'TO:' TO TICKET-LINE(44:3) 
     MOVE FULLCITY2 TO TICKET-LINE(48:20) 
     MOVE '|' TO TICKET-LINE(70:1) 
     DISPLAY TICKET-LINE 
                                                                  
     MOVE SPACE TO TICKET-LINE 
     MOVE '|' TO TICKET-LINE(70:1) 
     MOVE 'DATE:' TO TICKET-LINE(73:5) 
     MOVE FDATE TO TICKET-LINE(79:10) 
     DISPLAY TICKET-LINE 
                                                         
     MOVE SPACE TO TICKET-LINE 
     MOVE 'FLIGHTID:' TO TICKET-LINE(11:9) 
     MOVE FLIGHTNUM TO TICKET-LINE(21:6) 
     MOVE 'DATE:' TO TICKET-LINE(32:5) 
     MOVE FULLDATE TO TICKET-LINE(39:9) 
     MOVE 'TIME:' TO TICKET-LINE(53:5) 
     MOVE TDEP TO TICKET-LINE(59:5) 
     MOVE '|' TO TICKET-LINE(70:1) 
     MOVE 'SEAT:' TO TICKET-LINE(73:5) 
     MOVE FSEAT TO TICKET-LINE(79:3) 
     DISPLAY TICKET-LINE 
                                                         
     MOVE SPACE TO TICKET-LINE 
     MOVE '|' TO TICKET-LINE(70:1) 
     DISPLAY TICKET-LINE.

plan.approach: The COBOL PRINTCI program performs two logical operations: (1) accept ten fixed-width character fields via JCL ACCEPT (stdin/SYSIN) and (2) format and DISPLAY those fields into a 95-character wide boarding-pass layout directed to a SYSOUT printer. The migration maps operation (1) to a validated JSON request body on a POST endpoint, and operation (2) to a dedicated TicketFormatterService whose formatTicket() method replicates every single MOVE-to-TICKET-LINE substring assignment, preserving exact COBOL 1-based column offsets by translating each (cobolOffset:length) pair to (cobolOffset-1) 0-based Java array indices. The formatted lines are returned in the response AND logged at INFO level, which replaces the SYSOUT/MSGCLASS printer destination. A Ticket JPA entity persists the raw field data to PostgreSQL, replacing the ephemeral JCL job invocation with a durable record that can be retrieved and re-rendered on demand.
patterns_used: DTO pattern with Java 17 records (TicketRequest, TicketResponse, ErrorResponse)
Repository pattern via Spring Data JPA (JpaRepository)
Strategy / Single-Responsibility: TicketFormatterService dedicated purely to formatting logic
Template Method – formatTicket() encapsulates all DISPLAY paragraph steps in order
plan.sql_strategy: The original COBOL program contains no EXEC SQL statements; all data was transient (ACCEPT/DISPLAY via JCL). PostgreSQL persistence was introduced as a modernisation enhancement. Spring Data JPA with Hibernate handles DDL (spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update) and CRUD. A custom @Query is provided for case-insensitive passenger-name search. Standard derived query method findByFlightNumber() covers flight-based lookup.
plan.call_strategy: The COBOL program issues no CALL statements. The two PERFORM paragraphs (0100-ACCEPT and 0200-DISPLAY) are mapped to: 0100-ACCEPT → TicketRequest record bound from the HTTP request body with Bean Validation enforcing PIC X(n) length constraints; 0200-DISPLAY → TicketFormatterService.formatTicket() which mirrors every MOVE/DISPLAY step as documented inline.
